headline: 紀錄片重探選秀天鵝
context: 導演Erin Lee Carr推出新紀錄片，重新檢視2004年美國福斯電視台的整型選秀節目《The Swan》。該節目讓32名女性接受大量整型手術，是當年最具爭議、也最殘酷的真人秀之一。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: In a new documentary, film-maker Erin Lee Carr lifts the lid on the 2000s TV series that shocked America It was in 2003, while listening to country radio, that Kelly first heard the casting call: “Have you dreamed about plastic surgery but never thought you could afford it?” She immediately turned up the volume. The pitch sounded too good to be true: free cosmetic procedures, a nutritionist, self-esteem work – one “life-changing opportunity” that “could transform everything”. Kristy, Cindy, Tawnya and Beth heard the call, too: the chance to overhaul oneself from the outside in, fulfilling the implicit but omnipresent promise that if you just lost a little weight and just tweaked your face a bit, your whole life would open up. You, too, could be an ugly duckling transfigured into a swan. The catch? It would all be filmed for television, of course, for a short-lived show that some have called one of the most sadistic of all time: The Swan. The Fox reality program, which ran for two seasons in 2004, brought the spectacle of intensive plastic surgery – the endurance of extreme pain and humiliation in pursuit of a narrow beauty ideal – to US living rooms with shocking bluntness: bandages and bruises, surgical cannulas pounding into flesh, curt assessments of lumps and bumps and “masculine” teeth that must be corrected in pursuit of a better you. Even among similarly thin-obsessed programs from the infamously ruthless wild west of early reality television – America’s Next Top Model and The Biggest Loser , to name a few – The Swan stands out as especially cruel, at once hopelessly bought into punitive beauty standards on-screen and shamelessly manipulative off it. 紀錄片重探選秀天鵝

導演Erin Lee Carr推出新紀錄片，重新檢視2004年美國福斯電視台的整型選秀節目《The Swan》。這個節目讓32名女性接受大量整型手術，是當年最具爭議、也最殘酷的真人秀之一，如今被視為預示了後來美貌文化的走向。

—— 本則整理自衛報與紐約時報 2026 年 9 月 30 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

紀錄片重探選秀天鵝

導演Erin Lee Carr推出新紀錄片，重新檢視2004年美國福斯電視台的整型選秀節目《The Swan》。這個節目讓32名女性接受大量整型手術，是當年最具爭議、也最殘酷的真人秀之一，如今被視為預示了後來美貌文化的走向。

本則整理自衛報與紐約時報於 2026 年 9 月 30 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有部新紀錄片，重新挖出2004年一檔極端整型真人秀。《The Swan》讓32名女性接受大量整型手術，是當年最具爭議、也最殘酷的真人秀之一。導演現在重新檢視這個節目，認為它其實預示了後來的美貌文化走向。
